events.title: emergent_supply_chain_pact
events.description: A coalition of mid-tier AI powers including South Korea, the Netherlands, Finland, and Taiwan formalizes a pact on shared compute procurement, mutual red-teaming, and aligned export licensing for critical AI components. The pact leverages collective control over chip materials and verification tools, conditioning access on adherence to common safety baselines, and begins to function as a counterweight to US-China dominance.

portfolio.name: Form the Middle Power AI Coalition (MPAC)
portfolio.description: Establish a binding coordination framework among the EU and like-minded middle powers to align export controls, jointly negotiate compute access, and pool evaluation capacity—without ceding sovereignty—creating collective leverage over frontier development and deployment

priority: Form the Middle Power AI Coalition
